latestVersion.changelog:
Amazon FBA Fee Calculator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Calculates Amazon referral fees, FBA fulfillment fees, storage costs, and net margin using the 2026 fee schedule.
- Supports all size tiers and 20+ product categories.
- Provides full profitability breakdown: profit per unit, margin %, ROI %, monthly/annual projections, and break-even price.
- Accepts options for shipping, weight, dimensions, category, PPC costs, and units sold.
- Easy command-line usage—requires only Python 3, no install or API keys needed.
